description: FactLot ID for a suite or unit within a building, given the building's FactLot URN (from id_building). Suite designators are normalized: "Suite 100", "Ste 100" and "#100" agree, while "1-20" and "120" stay distinct.

building_urn.description: FactLot building URN from id_building, e.g. fl:building:us-11001:20002:208-massachusetts-ave-ne (a minted fl:building:<26-character token> also works).

suite.description: Suite or unit as written ("Suite 400", "STE 400", "#400", "3rd Floor" all normalize).

name: id_space
title: FactLot space (suite) ID
